caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a mug with a wide base and a narrower top, featuring a decorative, ornate handle on the right side. The mug has a flared body that curves inward toward the top and widens again at the rim. There is a small rectangular label near the top with the word "ENDURA" written inside. The handle is elaborate, curving upward and outward with additional inward curls near the endpoints. The mug stands on a pedestal-like foot that is slightly layered. The image is rendered in thin black lines on a plain, slightly yellowed or beige-toned background, with no shading or color within the drawing itself. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature, "Lawrence Flynn." There are some faint marks and small spots visible on the background.
title: Silver Mug
